supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension beyond the outer corners of the eyes is visible and continuous with the orbital rim

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast with light grey/white muzzle pixels against dark black cheek and periocular pixels

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin, linear resting profile with no visible drooping

other_distinctive_markers: uniform light-colored depigmentation or graying across the entire muzzle and chin area
